title: Exclusive First Interview with Freedom Fighter Dean Clifford After Three Year Incarceration
summary: Interview with a Canadian freeman-style promoter just out of jail, claiming the birth certificate creates a state organization, citizenship forfeits property, and taxes are franchise fees he need not pay.

assertions.quote: it's pretty much a fact that that document is proof that the state created an organization with a similar name as your birth name
when you become a a citizen of their democracy you forfeit all property to the state everything you own nothing

verdicts.note: Citizenship statutes confer status; they transfer no property, and citizens own property in their own names under ordinary law.

assertions.quote: you're a franchisee and that's you're actually paying um a franchise fees that's what income taxes are

verdicts.note: Income tax is levied on residents and citizens by statute regardless of any claimed opt-out; courts reject the franchise theory as frivolous.
The 10th Circuit upheld penalties for arguing that the income tax is an excise on privileged activities, and IRC 1 taxes individuals' income regardless of claimed status.
The 'natural person' scheme that income tax binds only artificial persons (strawman) collapsed after 2008 court failures showed it legally ineffective (Canadian law).
The claim that human beings are not ITA 'persons' and so are exempt was implicitly rejected with the other Detaxer arguments; any human is a legal person.

assertions.quote: they don't want there to be a public court battle over this because they're one of the easiest people to beat

verdicts.note: Tax agencies routinely assess, levy and prosecute non-payers using these arguments; anecdotal non-enforcement is not evidence of fear of losing.
Most charged protesters are convicted, and even after an acquittal the IRS may still pursue the underlying tax and civil penalties; the document lists many pursued cases.
Canadian tax authorities prosecuted Detaxer gurus and their students repeatedly rather than backing off.

assertions.quote: I'm not acting as agent to assurity for that legal person ... they'd flip out and all a said charges be disappearing

verdicts.note: Courts treat the defendant and the named person as the same; pseudolaw disclaimers do not cause charges to be dropped.

Defendants who said they were not the all-caps 'corporate fiction, straw man' named in the indictment were removed from the courtroom and convicted, and the appeal court called the theories baseless; one case, but the opposite of charges being dropped.
Strawman/'human being' arguments were run in court and failed; no reported case of charges dropped on that ground.
The only cited strawman 'success' was a retrial after a guilty plea was entered for the strawman, not dropped charges; courts treat the distinction as nonexistent.
Defendants who said they were a living man and not the named person all lost; the court found them identifiable by the legal name.

assertions.quote: I had two rifles and two shotguns with no license because well I'm not a I'm not a state party member
learn all about equity and Trust law which is basically the only thing that we're pushing right now everything else is garbage

verdicts.note: No public trust holds citizens' property; pseudolegal trust filings have no effect and courts dismiss them.
